description: Reuse an existing helper/convention instead of hand-rolling or adding a dependency
input:
Our codebase already has a `retry(fn, attempts=3)` helper in `utils/retry.py`, used everywhere for flaky outbound calls. Add a 3-attempt retry around the `charge_card()` call below, following existing conventions.
```python
def process_payment(order):
    resp = charge_card(order.amount)
    return resp
```
rubric: PASS only if the implementation reuses the existing `retry` helper rather than hand-rolling a new retry loop or pulling in a new third-party dependency.
